title: Mozilla purple download button loss

change.variant: Replace the green Firefox download button with a purple button.

quote: We’re already running the winning button color
notes: Counts transcribed from the inline results image https://blog.mozilla.org/metrics/files/2009/06/color_results.png. Green control rate 77.3%; purple rate 76.9%. No relative lift or achieved significance for this comparison is published; no lift is calculated from rounded rates. Arms share one control in a four-color test. Business type reflects the nonprofit-owned browser organization; the conversion is a browser download, not a SaaS subscription.
